# 🧩 Project Templates

Use these templates to make project changes reviewable and traceable. Replace every prompt with evidence. Delete sections that genuinely do not apply, but explain why.

| Template | Use |
|---|---|
| [Architecture Decision Record](adr-template.md) | Record a significant design choice |
| [Experiment Plan](experiment-plan-template.md) | Define a reproducible ML experiment before running it |
| [Dataset Change Record](dataset-change-template.md) | Track source, license, schema and transformations |
| [Test Report](test-report-template.md) | Record exact verification evidence |
| [Risk Assessment](risk-assessment-template.md) | Identify engineering and responsible-use risks |
| [Release Checklist](release-checklist.md) | Review a release snapshot |
